title: Astronaut crew quarters: something came back with them
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Astronaut crew quarters: something came back with them, about late 1950s-present at Crew quarters, Cape Canaveral, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: never be the same. He said that every time that thing went up, when it came back down, something came with them and it was still there.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts UFOs and has been studied by NASA, told podcast host Jesse Michels what a man named Timothy Taylor told him about the astronauts' living quarters at Cape Canaveral, the Florida rocket launch site. According to Bledsoe, Taylor said that every time a craft went up and came back down, something came back with the crew, and it was still there in those quarters. If true, it would mean early spaceflights brought some unseen presence back to Earth.
